item.text:
Subject: Neighborhood Plant Pot Swap

Hi neighbors,

Do you have extra plant pots gathering dust? Join us for a friendly pot swap! Bring any clean pots, trays, or planters you no longer need, and take home something new for your plants.

Please come even if you have nothing to bring—everyone is welcome to browse, chat, and enjoy meeting fellow plant lovers.

Hope to see you there!

Best,  
[Your Name]
